title: Flux General RF Inversion
description: A general purpose endpoint for the FLUX.1 [dev] model, implementing the RF-Inversion pipeline. This can be used to edit a reference image based on a prompt.

estimate.note: billed by compute time - no per-run figure

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt to edit the image with

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the generated image. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: The number of inference steps to perform.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: loras
inputs.tooltip: The LoRAs to use for the image generation. You can use any number of LoRAs and they will be merged together to generate the final image. JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: control_loras
inputs.tooltip: The LoRAs to use for the image generation which use a control image. You can use any number of LoRAs and they will be merged together to generate the final image. JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: controlnets
inputs.tooltip: The controlnets to use for the image generation. Only one controlnet is supported at the moment. JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: controlnet_unions
inputs.tooltip: The controlnet unions to use for the image generation. Only one controlnet is supported at the moment. JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: easycontrols
inputs.tooltip: EasyControl Inputs to use for image generation. JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: fill_image_fill_image
inputs.tooltip: URLs of images to be filled for redux prompting Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.tooltip: The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

inputs.name: use_cfg_zero
inputs.tooltip: Uses CFG-zero init sampling as in https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18886.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate. This is always set to 1 for streaming output.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.

inputs.name: reference_image
inputs.tooltip: URL of Image for Reference-Only

inputs.name: reference_strength
inputs.tooltip: Strength of reference_only generation. Only used if a reference image is provided.

inputs.name: reference_start
inputs.tooltip: The percentage of the total timesteps when the reference guidance is to bestarted.

inputs.name: reference_end
inputs.tooltip: The percentage of the total timesteps when the reference guidance is to be ended.

inputs.name: base_shift
inputs.tooltip: Base shift for the scheduled timesteps

inputs.name: max_shift
inputs.tooltip: Max shift for the scheduled timesteps

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: use_beta_schedule
inputs.tooltip: Specifies whether beta sigmas ought to be used.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.tooltip: Scheduler for the denoising process.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.tooltip: Negative prompt to steer the image generation away from unwanted features. By default, we will be using NAG for processing the negative prompt. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: nag_scale
inputs.tooltip: The scale for NAG. Higher values will result in a image that is more distant to the negative prompt.

inputs.name: nag_tau
inputs.tooltip: The tau for NAG. Controls the normalization of the hidden state. Higher values will result in a less aggressive normalization, but may also lead to unexpected changes with respect to the original image. Not recommended to change this value.

inputs.name: nag_alpha
inputs.tooltip: The alpha value for NAG. This value is used as a final weighting factor for steering the normalized guidance (positive and negative prompts) in the direction of the positive prompt. Higher values will result in less steering on the normalized guidance where lower values will result in considering the positive prompt guidance more.

inputs.name: nag_end
inputs.tooltip: The proportion of steps to apply NAG. After the specified proportion of steps has been iterated, the remaining steps will use original attention processors in FLUX.

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: URL of image to be edited

inputs.name: controller_guidance_forward
inputs.tooltip: The controller guidance (gamma) used in the creation of structured noise.

inputs.name: controller_guidance_reverse
inputs.tooltip: The controller guidance (eta) used in the denoising process.Using values closer to 1 will result in an image closer to input.

inputs.name: reverse_guidance_start
inputs.tooltip: Timestep to start guidance during reverse process.

inputs.name: reverse_guidance_end
inputs.tooltip: Timestep to stop guidance during reverse process.

inputs.name: reverse_guidance_schedule
inputs.tooltip: Scheduler for applying reverse guidance.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
